title: PMO Impact Pitch — Single-page interactive interview narrative

requirements.summary: Build a responsive single-page narrative with clearly labeled navigation to all required sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing view includes clearly labeled navigation to: Executive Pitch, About Me, Success Criteria, Impact, 90‑Day Roadmap.
Layout is usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop (no horizontal scrolling; typography scales appropriately).
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page layout and wire all required sections in-order (Executive Pitch, About Me, Success Criteria, Impact, 90‑Day Roadmap) with in-page navigation/scroll targeting and a responsive container.

Add a sticky/top navigation component with labeled links that scroll to each section. Use shadcn/ui primitives (e.g., Button) to keep consistent styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a reusable section wrapper (title, subtitle, spacing, anchor id) to ensure consistent spacing/typographic hierarchy across the single page.

requirements.summary: Implement the Executive Pitch hero section with a crisp PMO/portfolio-governance pitch and a clear call-to-action, subtly tailored for Sanjeev & Martin.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section contains one concise pitch paragraph and a clear call-to-action (e.g., “Explore impact”).
Hero section includes “Sanjeev” and “Martin” text somewhere on the page without claiming any personal details about them.
The pitch reads as a PMO/portfolio-governance profile (governance, lifecycle integrity, automation, cross-region alignment).

file_operations.description: Create the hero section with a professional headline, one concise pitch paragraph, a subtle line like “Tailored for Sanjeev & Martin”, and a CTA that scrolls to the next key section. Use shadcn/ui Button and Card where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated hero background image asset and reference it from the hero section as a decorative background (no identity claims).
Wire HeroExecutivePitch into the top of the single page and connect the CTA to scroll to a later section (e.g., Success Criteria or Impact).

requirements.summary: Add an About Me section summarizing 7 years PMO experience and explicit alignment to the four success criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: About Me section includes: years of experience, core strengths, and a short alignment list referencing the four success criteria.
Content is scannable (headline + bullet points) and visually distinct from other sections.

file_operations.description: Implement the About Me section with a headline, short summary, and bullet list aligning explicitly to: transparent & reliable data, governance/process adherence, reduced bottlenecks, improved reporting/automation. Use shadcn/ui Card for scannability. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire AboutMeSection into the single-page flow with a stable anchor id used by the navigation.

requirements.summary: Create an interactive Success Criteria module with 6 tabs/buttons, showing 3 STAR stories for each of the four success criteria, plus Impact and 90‑Day Roadmap Plan tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: UI shows 6 clearly clickable buttons/tabs; the selected one is visually highlighted.
Each of the four success criteria reveals 3 STAR blocks with headings: Situation, Task, Action, Result.

STAR content matches the user-provided initiatives (demand review globalization, PM training/KT assets, ServiceNow ITAM inventory; resource-first policy, extension governance, compliance improvement; MS Planner visibility, weekly patch cadence, onboarding manuals; PM availability dashboard, resource dashboard, resource-plan automation).
Only one section is expanded/visible at a time (unless explicitly designed as an accordion with clear separation).

file_operations.description: Add structured English copy for: four success criteria labels and their 3 STAR stories each, plus short summaries for the Impact and 90‑Day Roadmap tabs, keeping content consistent across sections.

Implement the 6-tab Success Criteria module using shadcn/ui Tabs (or equivalent shadcn/ui toggle primitives) to ensure only one panel is visible at a time, and render STAR blocks with explicit Situation/Task/Action/Result headings. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated minimal icon set asset and use it in the Success Criteria module to visually differentiate the four criteria (no extra icon generation beyond the provided file).
Wire SuccessCriteriaModule into the page and ensure the navigation link scrolls to it.

requirements.summary: Implement the Impact view with at least 12 skimmable before/after statements presented visually (e.g., cards).
acceptanceCriteria: Impact view includes at least 12 concise before/after statements derived from the described work (silos→global transparency; Excel→ServiceNow ITAM; 77%→100% compliance; week-late VP updates→real-time; quarterly→weekly patching; etc.).
Impact is presented in a way that is understandable even when skimming (cards, badges, or metrics-style layout).

file_operations.description: Create the Impact section rendering at least 12 before/after statements in a two-column card layout (Before vs After) optimized for skimming. Use shadcn/ui Card and Badge components for visual hierarchy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/ensure at least 12 before/after statements derived from the 12 activities (e.g., silos→global transparency; Excel→ServiceNow ITAM; 77%→100% compliance; week-late VP updates→near real-time; quarterly→weekly patching; etc.).
Wire ImpactSection into the page and ensure navigation scrolls to it; optionally connect the Hero CTA or Success Criteria 'Impact' tab action to scroll here.

requirements.summary: Implement the 90‑Day Roadmap Plan view broken into Days 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 with concrete PMO actions focused on governance, lifecycle integrity, automation, dashboards, and enablement.
acceptanceCriteria: Roadmap view shows three time blocks (1–30, 31–60, 61–90) with bullet points.
Roadmap language emphasizes scalable, repeatable systems and governance/data integrity (matching the interview positioning requested).

file_operations.description: Create the Roadmap section with three clearly labeled blocks (Days 1–30, 31–60, 61–90) and PMO-relevant bullet points emphasizing lifecycle integrity, governance control points, automation/validation, dashboards, and enablement/training. Use shadcn/ui Card/Accordion for readability. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add concrete 1–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 bullet content in English, aligned with the requested governance and scalable systems emphasis.
Wire Roadmap90DaySection into the page and ensure navigation scrolls to it; optionally connect Success Criteria '90‑Day Roadmap Plan' tab action to scroll here.

requirements.summary: Include the two uploaded images in an optional Reference/Notes collapsible section or modal without asserting personal identity details.
acceptanceCriteria: A collapsible panel or modal can display the uploaded images.
No text on the site identifies or asserts who is in the images; the images are presented as generic reference notes only.

file_operations.description: Add the first uploaded reference image as a static asset for optional viewing in the Reference/Notes section.
Add the second uploaded reference image as a static asset for optional viewing in the Reference/Notes section.

Create a collapsible panel or modal that displays the two reference images with neutral framing text (e.g., “Reference notes”) and no identity claims. Use shadcn/ui Collapsible or Dialog components as appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ReferenceNotes into the page near the end (or in the header/footer area) so it is optional and does not dominate the primary narrative.

requirements.summary: Establish a consistent executive-governance design system (typography, spacing, components) using a non blue+purple primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across hero, buttons/tabs, cards, and typography.
Color palette is not blue+purple as the primary combination (unless the user later requests it).
Design remains professional and readable (sufficient contrast; clear hierarchy).

file_operations.description: Add global styles and theme tokens (Tailwind base/components/utilities and CSS variables) to establish a warm-neutral, executive look (e.g., charcoal/stone + muted accent) and consistent typography/spacing across sections.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions (if needed) to support the chosen non blue+purple primary palette and ensure consistent spacing/typography defaults across the app.
Apply consistent layout patterns and reusable section styling so hero, tabs/buttons, cards, and headings share a coherent executive-governance visual language.
